annotation.title_clean: Η Επιτροπή δημοσιεύει κατευθυντήριες γραμμές σχετικά με τον ορισμό του συστήματος ΤΝ για τη διευκόλυνση της εφαρμογής των κανόνων της πρώτης πράξης για την ΤΝ
annotation.title_en: The Commission publishes guidelines on the AI system definition to facilitate application of the first AI Act rules
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, DG CONNECT (Shaping Europe's digital future)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing non-binding guidelines on the definition of an AI system under the EU AI Act, published alongside guidelines on prohibited practices. It notes the first AI Act rules applied from 2 February 2025 and lists downloads of the guidelines in all EU languages.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines help providers determine whether a software system is an AI system under the AI Act.
Guidelines are non-binding and will be updated over time.
Published alongside guidelines on prohibited AI practices.
First AI Act rules (AI system definition, AI literacy, prohibitions) applied from 2 February 2025.
